description: Ministry of Higher Education, Technology & Innovations - Powers & Functions delegate to the State Ministers of Technology & Innovations
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific individuals (Bandula Gunawardena and Thilanga Sumathipala) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It names the individuals and provides extensive details about the specific duties, functions, departments, statutory institutions, and laws being delegated, which meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3) that includes both "who" (government personnel) and "what" (detailed government responsibilities).
